name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A plug-in pack that turns an AI coding assistant into a trained bug-bounty hunter, teaching it hundreds of real attack patterns against websites and corporate networks.
buyer: A freelance bug bounty hunter or boutique penetration-testing consultancy who wants to find more vulnerabilities faster and win more bounties or client contracts.
business_use_cases: A freelance pentester uses it to triage a new client's web app overnight, surfacing likely vulnerability classes before the on-site engagement even starts.
A boutique security consultancy standardizes every engagement on this skill bundle so junior testers can produce senior-level findings.
A bug bounty hunter runs it against newly launched startups' sites to find exploitable patterns before an official bounty program fills up.

money_ideas.idea: Run a paid managed bug-hunting service where you use the toolkit against clients' own infrastructure and sell the vulnerability report.
Offer a hosted/managed version with compliance reporting for security teams who don't want to run Claude Code themselves.

steal_this: This weekend, run it against 2-3 bug bounty programs you already have access to on HackerOne or Bugcrowd and submit findings for bounty payouts — the tool itself is the product here, not something to wrap.
